concepts.name: Counseling Agency Registry
concepts.summary: The Agency JPA entity in api/repository/agency together with AgencyRepository is the master record for a counselling agency: name, description, address and contact fields, geo coordinates, opening hours, logo, offline flag and a soft delete marker. Its column set is grown exclusively through Liquibase changesets such as addAgencyAddressContact.sql, addAgencyOpeningHours.sql and addAgencyGeocoordinates.sql. AgencyService and AgencyAdminService are the only services that read and write it directly.

concepts.name: Agency Administration
concepts.summary: AgencyAdminController exposes the /agencyadmin surface and delegates to AgencyAdminService for create, update, changetype, merge and delete. Every write passes AgencyValidator, which runs the ConcreteAgencyValidator implementations (consulting type, postcode, demographics, offline status, tenant, update permission) before persistence. HAL links for the admin API are assembled by AgencyLinksBuilder and RootDTOBuilder.

concepts.name: Agency Search & Matching
concepts.summary: AgencyService.findAgencies builds an AgencySearch value object from postcode, consulting type, topic, age and gender and dispatches to searchWithTopic or searchWithoutTopic. The repository chosen at runtime is AgencyTenantAwareRepository or AgencyTenantUnawareRepository depending on multitenancy; addWhiteSpotAgency injects the WhiteSpot fallback agency when nothing matches.

concepts.name: Department = Agency x Topic
concepts.summary: A department is the AgencyTopic join entity: one row per agency and topic, carrying its own publication status, details, imprint and data-protection content. AgencyTopicMergeService reconciles the topic list sent by the admin UI against existing rows, while AgencyTopicEnrichmentService and TopicEnrichmentService hydrate topic ids with display data fetched from the Topic Service.

concepts.name: Legal Text Inheritance Chain
concepts.summary: LegalTextInheritanceResolver resolves the data-protection text and the imprint for a department by walking fromDepartment, then fromAgency, then fromTenantChain, tagging the winner with a LegalTextSourceLevel. loadGoverningTenant plus isTenantLevelLegalContentOverrideAllowed decide whether a tenant may override the central text at all; CentralDataProtectionTemplateService supplies the platform-level template when it may not.

concepts.name: Legal Text Versioning and Publication
concepts.summary: LegalText holds the editable record (kind, level, label, translations) and LegalTextVersion an immutable snapshot per publication. LegalTextVersionService.recordPublication writes a new version and supersedeCurrent retires the previous one; LegalTextAdminService calls recordPublicationIfPublished on every create and update so the published history is never rewritten in place.

concepts.name: Legal Content Sanitizing and Tokens
concepts.summary: LegalContentSanitizer.sanitizeToJson cleans the per-language rich text before it is stored, and LegalTextTokens.restoreKnownTokens plus escapeForHtml protect the placeholder tokens the sanitizer would otherwise destroy. ConsentTextService.sanitizeAndValidate additionally enforces that mandatory tokens are present before a consent text may be published, and PublicLegalTextRenderer substitutes server-owned values at read time.

concepts.name: Postcode Range Catchment Areas
concepts.summary: AgencyPostcodeRange rows define which postcodes an agency serves. AgencyPostcodeRangeAdminService creates, updates and deletes them behind the /agencyadmin/postcoderanges endpoints, with PostcodeRangeTransformer parsing the admin input and PostcodeRangeValidator rejecting malformed or overlapping ranges. AgencyPostcodeValidator applies the same rule set during agency create and update.

concepts.name: Tenant Resolution and Scoping
concepts.summary: TenantResolverService chains AccessTokenTenantResolver, CustomHeaderTenantResolver, SubdomainTenantResolver, TechnicalUserTenantResolver and MultitenancyWithSingleDomainTenantResolver, cross-validating the results before writing TenantContext. HttpTenantFilter runs the chain per request and TenantHibernateInterceptor stamps the tenant id on persisted rows; repositories opt in or out through the TenantAware and TenantUnaware markers.

concepts.name: Agency ID Reservation
concepts.summary: Agency ids are handed out explicitly rather than by auto-increment. AgencyIdAllocationService offers checkAvailability, nextFreeId, reserve and release backed by the AgencyIdReservation entity, and guardAssignmentAgainstOpenReservations stops an agency create from stealing an id somebody else has reserved. AgencyAdminService.saveWithReservationGuard consumes the reservation inside the create transaction.

concepts.name: Admin Roles and Permission Toggles
concepts.summary: Authority and RoleAuthorizationAuthorityMapper translate Keycloak realm roles into Spring authorities, and JwtAuthConverter wires that into SecurityConfig. Beyond roles, AgencyAdminControlEntity stores per-tenant permission toggles that AgencyAdminControlsFacade guards with assertSuperAdmin; LegalAdminAccessGuard adds the finer checks (restricted admin owns the agency, caller tenant matches) used across the legal services.

concepts.name: Downstream Service Clients
concepts.summary: The service is a client of five siblings: ConsultingTypeService, TopicService, TenantService, ApplicationSettingsService and the Appointment Service, each reached through a generated API client and a per-request controller factory under config/apiclient. RestTemplateConfig, SecurityHeaderSupplier and TenantHeaderSupplier attach the correlation id, bearer token and tenant header, and CustomResponseErrorHandler maps downstream failures onto the service's own exception types.

flows.name: Asker Searches Agencies → Matching Agency List
flows.summary: GET /agencies reaches AgencyController.getAgencies, which calls AgencyService.findAgencies; buildAgencySearch assembles postcode, consulting type, topic, age and gender, verifyConsultingTypeExists checks the type via ConsultingTypeService, and executeAgencySearch queries AgencyTenantAwareRepository or AgencyTenantUnawareRepository. convertToAgencyResponseDTO then renders the response, adding the WhiteSpot agency when the result set is empty.

flows.name: Admin Creates Agency → Persisted Agency with Topics
flows.summary: POST /agencyadmin/agencies enters AgencyAdminController.createAgency and AgencyAdminService.createAgency. AgencyValidator runs the create-annotated validators, setTenantIdOnCreate and setDefaultCounsellingRelationsIfEmpty fill defaults, AgencyTopicMergeService.getMergedTopics builds the AgencyTopic rows, and saveWithReservationGuard persists through AgencyRepository while consuming any AgencyIdReservation. AgencyAdminFullResponseDTOBuilder returns the HAL representation.

flows.name: Admin Searches Agencies → Paged HAL Result
flows.summary: GET /agencyadmin/agencies is handled by AgencyAdminController.searchAgencies and AgencyAdminSearchService.searchAgencies. Depending on the keyword it takes searchAgenciesByKeyword or searchAgenciesWithoutKeywordFilter, always composing tenantScopePredicate and createPredicateForAgencyAdmin so a restricted admin only sees its own agencies, then applySortingAndPagination. AgencyAdminSearchTenantSupportService supplies the tenant context and SearchResultLinkBuilder the paging links.

flows.name: Admin Publishes Department Data Protection → New Legal Text Version
flows.summary: PUT /agencyadmin/agencies/{agencyId}/topics/{topicId}/dpp calls AgencyAdminController.publishDepartmentDataProtection and DepartmentDataProtectionService.publishDepartmentDataPrivacy. The service asserts the caller through assertRestrictedAdminOwnsAgency and assertCallerTenantMatches, sanitizes the payload with LegalContentSanitizer, writes the AgencyTopic row, and LegalTextVersionService.recordPublication snapshots the result. DepartmentImprintService follows the identical shape for the imprint endpoint.

flows.name: Visitor Requests Department Legal Text → Rendered Published Text
flows.summary: GET /agencies/{agencyId}/topics/{topicId}/legal reaches AgencyController.getDepartmentLegal and DepartmentLegalService.getPublishedDepartmentLegal, which refuses deleted agencies via assertAgencyIsNotDeleted. LegalTextInheritanceResolver picks the department, agency or tenant text, DepartmentLegalPublicationState reports whether it counts as published, and PublicLegalTextRenderer.render substitutes the server-owned placeholder values before the DTO is returned.

flows.name: Admin Edits Postcode Ranges → Updated Catchment Area
flows.summary: The /agencyadmin/postcoderanges/{agencyId} endpoints map onto AgencyAdminController.createAgencyPostcodeRange, updateAgencyPostcodeRange and deleteAgencyPostcodeRange, all delegating to AgencyPostcodeRangeAdminService. PostcodeRangeTransformer parses the submitted ranges, validateAndSavePostcodeRanges runs PostcodeRangeValidator, and the rows are written through AgencyPostcodeRangeRepository; AgencyPostcodeRangeResponseDTOBuilder shapes the reply.

flows.name: Admin Reserves Agency ID → Held ID for Later Create
flows.summary: GET /agencyadmin/agencyids/next-free and POST /agencyadmin/agencyids/reservations reach AgencyAdminController.getNextFreeAgencyId and reserveAgencyId, which call AgencyIdAllocationService.nextFreeId, reserveSpecificId or reserveSmallestFreeId. isAssigned checks AgencyRepository, validateTenant checks the caller, and the reservation is stored in AgencyIdReservationRepository until consumeReservation runs during agency creation or release frees it again.

flows.name: Scheduler Purges Deleted Agencies → Rows Removed and Appointments Cleaned
flows.summary: DELETE /agencyadmin/agencies/{agencyId} only marks the agency, after DeleteAgencyValidator has confirmed it may go. DeleteAgenciesMarkedForDeletionScheduler later triggers DeleteAgencyService.deleteAgenciesMarkedForDeletion, which runs AgencyPurgeTransaction per agency to remove the agency and its dependants, and calls AppointmentService.deleteAgency so the Appointment Service drops its copy as well.

flows.name: Agency Requests Matrix Account → Stored Encrypted Credentials
flows.summary: AgencyController.provisionAgencyMatrixCredentials calls AgencyService.provisionMatrixCredentials, which hands over to MatrixProvisioningService.ensureAgencyAccount. That method sanitizes the username, generates a password, fetches the admin nonce and access token and registers the user against the homeserver configured by MatrixConfig, or resets the password when the user already exists. AgencyMatrixPasswordCipher encrypts the secret before it is written to the Agency row added by addAgencyMatrixColumns.sql.

flows.name: Request Arrives → Tenant Context Set for the Thread
flows.summary: CorrelationIdFilter and HttpTenantFilter run before the controllers; the tenant filter asks TenantResolverService.resolve, which picks the non-authenticated or authenticated resolver chain, uses SubdomainExtractor for host-based resolution and validateResolvedTenantMatch to reject conflicting hints. The winner is stored in TenantContext, TenantAspect keeps it aligned around service calls, and TenantHibernateInterceptor applies it to persisted entities.

layerDescriptions.Domain Concepts: Orientation catalogue for agency registration and administration, public matching, legal text inheritance/versioning/sanitizing, postcode catchments, tenant scoping, agency ID reservation, admin authorization, and downstream clients.
layerDescriptions.API Endpoints: The 134 REST operations declared in the OpenAPI specifications under api/ and services/, covering both this service's own /agencies and /agencyadmin routes and the sibling-service contracts it consumes.
layerDescriptions.API Layer: Controllers, admin and public services, repositories, entities, validators and DTO builders under de.caritas.cob.agencyservice.api - the bulk of the business logic.
layerDescriptions.Middleware Layer: Servlet filters and cross-cutting request plumbing: CorrelationIdFilter, HttpTenantFilter, StatelessCsrfFilter, SubdomainExtractor and the tenant aspect that surround every request.
layerDescriptions.Core: Application bootstrap and shared infrastructure, including AgencyServiceApplication, the global exception handlers and the utility classes used across packages.
layerDescriptions.Configuration Layer: Spring configuration under de.caritas.cob.agencyservice.config plus the OpenAPI and container descriptors: security, CORS, caching, FreeMarker, tracing, RestTemplate and the generated API client factories.
layerDescriptions.Test Layer: Test sources and fixtures accompanying the main code, including the unit and integration tests for the legal, tenant and admin services.
